scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @pitpal/server" "npm run dev -w @pitpal/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pitpal/shared && npm run build -w @pitpal/server && npm run build -w @pitpal/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pitpal/shared && npm run test -w @pitpal/server
scripts.build:api: esbuild server/src/vercel-entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=server/dist/bundle.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build -w @pitpal/client && npm run build:api
